propositions: fetcher._iter_pages terminates on short pages and advances by requested page_size, causing 92% of issues to be silently lost when a Jira Data Center server caps maxResults below the requested size
the pager must advance by len(page) and terminate only on empty pages to recover all results from truncated paginated responses, matching the fix already applied to get_parent_map
a server that ignores startAt and returns the same full page repeatedly must raise SilentTruncationError rather than loop indefinitely, with a bounded-time guarantee
existing behaviors (cap clipping, ACLI ceiling, same-token-twice cursor stall guard) must remain unchanged to preserve the Cloud bridge contract
